repos_data.description: Codebase intelligence for AI and humans: code health scores, auto-generated docs, git analytics, dead code detection, and architectural decisions via MCP.

Codebase intelligence for TypeScript and JavaScript. Health, complexity hotspots, duplication, architecture boundaries, circular dependencies, design-system drift, and unused code, from one graph. CLI, GitHub Action, LSP, MCP, and VS Code. Rust, MIT licensed.

Open source local-first PR scanner that finds dead code, security bugs, secrets, quality regressions, and AI-code mistakes before merge. For first timers refer to https://duriantaco.github.io/skylos/repo-map/
The missing context layer for AI-assisted refactoring
